questions.qtext: Which of the following option(s) is/are correct?

options.text: Settlement of single pile as compared to settlement of pile group is less.
Settlement of single pile as compared to settlement of pile group is more.
If thickness of sampler increases then corresponding disturbance increases.
If thickness of sampler increases then corresponding disturbance of collected soil sample decreases.

questions.solution:
(a, c)
• Split spoon sampler has a larger area ratio, so with the sampler having a thicker wall, it is impossible to get the undisturbed sample.
• Due to soil disturbances during pile installation and pile stress zone overlap, the settlement
of a group of friction piles is greater than the settlement of a single pile.
